title: Stand up the Chattic.us-web repository skeleton consuming the shared package

comments.author: home
comments.text:
New repository: AnthusAI/Chattic.us-web, private. Next.js app (static export),
its own package.json depending on the main repo by branch tarball:

  "chatticus": "https://github.com/AnthusAI/Chattic.us/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz"

mirroring the anthus-vultus pattern already in web/package.json. Its own
tsconfig, tailwind config extending the exported preset with content globs
reaching into ./node_modules/chatticus/web/**, its own lockfile, its own CI.

This is the empty shell tasks 8-9 populate.

comments.author: home
comments.text: AnthusAI/Chattic.us-web created (private). Pushed initial commit 031354c to main: standalone Next.js app depending on chatticus (main branch tarball) for the shared UI kit; package.json, tsconfig, next.config.ts, tailwind config, ESLint/PostCSS config, behave.ini, CI workflow (web+infra jobs), and deploy-marketing-production.yml all in place. Verified locally against the real main tarball: npm run build/typecheck/test green (34/34 unit tests), behave 5/5 features (31 scenarios, 123 steps). infra/ CDK app (ChatticusMarketingGitHubDeploy + ChatticusMarketing) synths cleanly with no AWS credentials; infra unit tests 5/5 green. Not yet deployed to AWS -- blocked on an interactive aws login this session cannot complete; see chatticus-544429 for the infra deploy itself.
